summary: P1 original-source full reading: admit How Much of Your VLA is kNN (p151, arXiv 2611.13160v1), 11 source-linked Chinese analysis sections, author code/reproducibility audit, three strictly scoped paper-table protocols (LIBERO 40×50, selected 420 LIBERO-Plus variants, LIBERO Table3 ablation) and 20 source-attributed result rows.
